changelog:
Every start now checks for a new version.

WHAT CHANGED

- The 12-hour rate limit governed the launch check too, so a fresh
  version could wait half a day to be noticed. Now every start checks,
  always; the 12 hours only limit repeat checks while the app stays
  open. The manual check on the About screen is unchanged.

WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Everything else, including the 0.3.3.16 second-opinion fix.
